angular_FOV_control.information_loss: Common crop truncates large objects and coarse sampling blurs small ones; no post-accuracy choice of representation, crop, kernel or scale.
angular_FOV_control.neutralized_or_controlled_information: Input angular field fixed4arcmin, common localTAN sampling15arcsec/pixel, added angular smoothing15arcsecFWHM and common16x16 effective grid; no adaptive-source-field intensity statistics. Do not feed originalFOV/headers into image models.
angular_FOV_control.not_certified_neutral: Original source PSF, survey plate grain, interpolation history and physical foreground/background may leave residual information. Do not call all FOV information eliminated.
angular_FOV_control.recipe: Complete representationB for every same eligible object and same split, regardless of source FOV or class. IfB is primary, A remains a contextual comparator.

decision_rule: Representation roles, all preprocessing, metadata features, grouping, split seed and analysis policy are frozen before model training/held-out evaluation. Every declared control is reported, regardless of whether it helps the preferred narrative. Controls cannot select a best test seed, trigger test-driven recuration, alternative acquisitions or retraining.

metadata_only.model: Fixed multinomial logistic regression, C=1, balanced class weights,max_iter=1000,lbfgs,no grid search. Nonconvergence is reported, not silently tuned. A depth3 decision tree is a separately reported fixed diagnostic, random_state=active_split_seed, no outcome-driven tuning.
metadata_only.preprocessing: Train-only median imputation for missing logextent; explicit missingness indicator; train-only centering/scaling on unique objects. No held-out fitting.
metadata_only.purpose: Measure available class information without pixels; association is not a causal leakage proof.

outer_field_control.A_mask: Raw-view central128x128 indices[192:320,192:320] on the512grid, identical for every object.
outer_field_control.B_mask: Central4x4 indices[6:10,6:10] on the16common grid, identical for every object.
outer_field_control.caveat: Outer field can contain true diffuse target emission or neighbours. This is an outer-field/target-masked stress control, not a certified pure-background image.
outer_field_control.intensity_rule: Estimate p01/p99 from unmasked pixels only, then the same asinh rule; masked region filled u=0 before fixed sizing and normalization. This prevents the removed target from leaking through whole-image stretch statistics.
outer_field_control.sizing_augmentation: Same recipe-specific output sizing and train-only D4 operation as the parent representation; no learned or class-dependent segmentation or fill.

stratified_reporting.empty_or_degenerate_strata: Report support and undefined metrics explicitly; never omit difficult bins or equate low support with equivalence.
stratified_reporting.extent_basis: Primary frozen source512-pixel extent proxy, plus separately labelled actual224-pixel A and16-pixel B extent proxies. Also report angular extent and its source definition; no repair of unknown/reversed/half-light values.
reports: object count and class support per stratum
